projectDescription: A suite of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that give Claude persistent memory, full-text search, and integration with personal knowledge management tools like Capacities.
keyFeatures: Persistent cross-session memory for Claude via SQLite + FTS5
Improved OR-expansion and prefix-wildcard full-text search (fork improvement)
Auto-summarization and named entity extraction on memory store
Importance-based TTL and hybrid relevance scoring on recall
Optional Substratia Cloud sync with offline queue and exponential backoff
Claude Code session import with sensitive data scrubbing and deduplication
Markdown folder bulk import into the memory database
CLI search, list, stats, and soft-delete over the memory database
Capacities PKM integration: search, read objects, save weblinks, daily notes
Authless remote MCP server template deployable to Cloudflare Workers
publicApiSurface: memory_store(content, type, id?, importance?, entities?, tags?, metadata?, ttl_days?, expires_at?, provenance?)
